lines.text: The Teacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem, says everything is futile and asks what a man gains from his labor.
Generations come and generations go, but the earth remains forever.
The sun rises and sets and hurries back to where it rises, while the wind blows eastward, then turns northward.
All the rivers flow into the sea, yet the sea is never full, and the eye is not satisfied with seeing.
There is nothing new under the sun, and those yet to come will be remembered by those who follow after.
